approach: Add one bullet to docs/system-facts.md: short prose (library and binary targets, where xtask code is tested, the reach rule, a Source naming the Cargo.toml files) and one nested line per workspace crate in the form `- crate <name>: lib|bin|lib+bin[; deps <list>][; dev <list>]`. Names drop `athena-`. `deps` is the workspace-internal [dependencies]. `dev` is the workspace-internal [dev-dependencies] not already in `deps`. An empty field is left out. Add `crate_rows()` and `check_crate_facts()` to crates/athena-cli/tests/budgets.rs. `crate_rows()` computes the truth from the Cargo.toml files and the src layout. `check_crate_facts()` compares the facts text with it line for line, and two new tests (one positive, one negative) drive it. Add a ninth, prose-only line to READING_RULES in briefs.rs. Update the array length, the doc comment, the rule-count assertion, the section-size cap (measured, not guessed) and the facts-file test (markers, 12 bullets). Add one CHANGELOG line. The failure-class merge and reading.rs are not touched.

decisions.choice: Compute the truth for the drift test from the Cargo.toml files, parsed with the `toml` crate that athena-cli already depends on, plus a src-layout check. Members come from the root `[workspace] members`. A target is `lib` if `src/lib.rs` or a `[lib]` table exists, and `bin` if a `[[bin]]` table, `src/main.rs` or `src/bin/` exists. `deps` is the sorted `athena-*` keys of [dependencies] with the prefix dropped. `dev` is the sorted `athena-*` keys of [dev-dependencies] with the prefix dropped, minus the keys already in deps. `check_crate_facts` builds the expected line set with `crate_line(row)`. It collects every `- crate ` line of the text and rejects an actual line not in the expected set (doctored, unknown or malformed), an expected line not present (missing crate) and a line that appears twice.
decisions.reason: Criterion 1 needs every claim checkable against the Cargo.toml files. Parsing needs no subprocess and no new dependency, so Cargo.lock is unchanged. Whole-line comparison against computed lines gives the doctored, missing, unknown, duplicate and malformed cases with one mechanism. I read all 12 manifests and the Glob of src files. Every crates/* package has src/lib.rs. athena-cli also has src/main.rs and the only `[[bin]]`. xtask has only src/main.rs.

This answers finding 1 and replaces the earlier decision to leave dev-dependencies out. The measured Grep shows 8 workspace-internal dev entries over 5 crates (core, agent and git have testkit; cli has context, core with the test-support feature and testkit; xtask has context and testkit). After the minus-deps rule the field appears on agent, core, git, cli and xtask.

Without `dev`, the line for cli would wrongly suggest that a cli test cannot reach context.
